info.title: Reach Checkout API
info.description:
November 2020
withreach.com
docs.withreach.com

Reach's Checkout API provides merchants the ability to execute and manage payment processing for consumer orders while retaining control over the shopper experience and limiting PCI DSS exposure. Creating payment orders, refunding payments, and querying available foreign exchange rates and payment methods are all provided by this JSON-based API.

post.description: Creates a merchant's order within Reach without billing information.

MerchantId.description: The 36 character GUID which identifies the merchant to the Reach system.

ReferenceId.description: An optional string identifying the order in the merchant's order management system.  If specified, this is returned in the notification of a processed order, so that the merchant's system can cross-reference the Reach order with the merchant's order data.

DeviceFingerprint.description: The device fingerprint as returned by Reach from the fingerprint request.

ConsumerCurrency.description: The upper-case 3 character ISO 4217 currency code which the shopper has indicated is their preferred currency. Required if RateOfferId is not specified.

RateOfferId.description: The 36 character GUID for a guaranteed foreign exchange rate. If omitted, the rate will be determined at the time of settlement.

Items.description: An array of objects containing information for each product in the shopper's order.

Sku.description: The merchant's Stock Keeping Unit for the item.

ConsumerPrice.description: The unit price of the item expressed in the consumer currency. This, combined with the Quantity, is used to produce the total item value. Prices with up to two decimal places of precision are supported.

PreorderDate.description: For a pre-ordered item, the expected date (in UTC) that the merchandise will be available, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Reorder.description: Indicates whether the consumer is reordering a previously purchased item.

GiftCard.description: Indicates whether this item is a gift card.

Shipping.description: If physical shipping of goods is required for this order, Shipping must be specified before authorization.

ConsumerPrice.description: The amount, including all service fees, surcharges, etc, but excluding taxes and duty, associated with the physical shipping option.

ConsumerTaxes.description: Taxes incurred for the entire order.

ConsumerDuty.description: Duty incurred for the entire order.

Timeframe.description:
Indicates the merchandise delivery timeframe. One of:
__SameDay__ - Same day shipping
__Overnight__ - Overnight shipping
__TwoOrMore__ - Two-day or more shipping

Charges.description: An optional array of objects containing additional charges associated with this order. The sum of all charges will be added to the total amount charged to the consumer.

ConsumerPrice.description: The consumer price associated with the charge.

Discounts.description: An optional array of objects containing discounts associated with this order. The sum of all discounts will be subtracted from the total amount charged to the consumer.

ConsumerPrice.description: The consumer price associated with the discount. Note that since this amount is subtracted from the total amount charged to the consumer, it _should not_ be negative.

Financing.description: Must be included if a financing option is selected by the consumer.

Instalments.description: The number of instalments in which the full amount will be charged.

ConsumerPrice.description: The consumer price charged to the consumer for the financing option, independent of the financing charge to the merchant returned by getPaymentMethods. Specified in the consumer currency.

ConsumerTotal.description: If specified, this serves as a check to ensure that the total amount charged to the consumer is as specified. The sum of all items and charges, plus the total amount associated with shipping (if applicable) minus the sum of all discounts, plus the financing price, must be equal to this amount.

Consumer.description: Consumer must be specified or collected before authorization.If not specified, it will be collected during authentication, if possible. If the request does not originate from the consumer's browser and payment details will be provided by the consumer, the IP address of the consumer must be specified either here or in a subsequent modify request.

Company.description: The company associated with the consumer, when applicable. Required if a corporate NationalIdentifier is specified (e.g. CNPJ in Brazil).

Phone.description: The consumer's phone number is required for some payment methods and/or countries. Ideally specified using E.164 formatting, but this is not enforced.

City.description: The city associated with the consumer's address.

Region.description: The ISO-3166-2 subdivision code for the region (state, province, etc.) associated with the consumer's address, not including the country code or dash. (eg NS, not CA-NS). This field may be omitted if there are no states/regions in the specified country.

PostalCode.description: The postal code associated with the consumer's address. This field may be omitted if there are no postal codes in the specified country.

Country.description: The upper-case ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code associated with the consumer's address.

NationalIdentifier.description: The country-specific unique identifier of the consumer, without punctuation.  It is required for some payment methods and/or countries and is commonly related to taxes.  Examples are SSN for the United States, SIN for Canada, CPF or CNPJ for Brazil or PAN for India.

BirthDate.description: Required for some payment methods and/or countries. Must be specified as YYYY-MM-DD.

IpAddress.description: If the request does not originate from the consumer's browser and ViaAgent is false, the IP address of the consumer must be specified before authorization.

ConsumerProfile.description: Optional information about the consumer's account with the merchant. This may be used for risk analysis, particularly for 3-D Secure version 2.

ConsumerProfileId.description: The merchant's identifier for the consumer's profile. If submitted, this will link the consumer's orders for use in fraud analysis.

OpenDate.description: Date (in UTC) that the consumer opened the account with the merchant. May be a YYYY-MM-DD date, ThisTime if the account was opened as part of this checkout, or Never for a guest checkout.

LastChange.description: Date (in UTC) that the consumer's account with the merchant was last changed, including billing or shipping address, new payment account, or new user(s) added. May be a YYYY-MM-DD date, ThisTime or Never.

LastPasswordChange.description: Date  (in UTC) that consumer's account with the merchant had a password change or account reset. May be a YYYY-MM-DD date, ThisTime or Never.

Purchases6Months.description: Number of purchases with this consumer account during the previous six months.

AddCardAttempts24Hours.description: Number of Add Card attempts by this consumer in the last 24 hours.

Transactions24Hours.description: Number of transactions (successful and abandoned) by this consumer in the previous 24 hours.

Transactions1Year.description: Number of transactions (successful and abandoned) by this consumer in the previous year.

HadSuspiciousActivity.description: Indicates whether the merchant has experienced suspicious activity (including previous fraud) on the consumer account.

Consignee.description: An object containing information about the consignee for the order. Consignee must be specified or collected before authorization if Shipping is present. If not specified and required, it will be collected during authentication if possible. This field is not allowed if Shipping is not present.

Phone.description: The consignee's phone number. Ideally specified using E.164 formatting, but this is not enforced.

City.description: The city associated with the consignee's address.

Region.description: The ISO-3166-2 subdivision code for the region (state, province, etc.) associated with the consumer's address, not including the country code or dash. (eg NS, not CA-NS). This field may be omitted if there are no states/regions in the specified country.

PostalCode.description: The postal code associated with the consignee's address. This field may be omitted if there are no postal codes in the specified country.

Country.description: The upper-case ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code associated with the consignee's address.

AddedDate.description: The date when this address was first used with the merchant. May be a YYYY-MM-DD date or ThisTime.

VerifiedAddress.description: Has this address been verified, e.g. by previously using it as a billing address for a card payment.

AcceptLiability.description: If true, the merchant accepts financial liability for this order. This is typically used for VIP or otherwise whitelisted consumers.

Store.description: An optional tag that can be used to categorize orders. Typically used when a merchant has multiple storefronts on their website but wishes to use the same Reach Merchant Id.

Return.description: The URL to which the consumer's browser will be redirected after external authentication (if necessary) has completed. See [Return from Redirect](https://docs.withreach.com/v2.20/reference#returnfromredirect). Required if a redirect is required.

Notify.description: An optional URL that will override the default notification URL configured for the merchant. All notifications related to this order, including refunds, will go to this override.

Locale.description: If known, the preferred locale of the consumer specified as an BCP 47 IETF language tag, as seen, for example, in an HTTP Accept-Language header. Extensions such as RFC 6067 Unicode Locale are accepted.

Meta.description: An opaque JSON value (string, number, boolean, array, or object) which is returned to the merchant in response to a query request for this order.

200.description: The order was successfully created in the Reach system.

OrderId.description: The 36 character GUID which identifies the order in the Reach system.

Expiry.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp by which authorization must be completed.

PaymentMethods.description: A list of payment methods that support external authentication prior to authorize.

PaymentMethod.description: The Reach canonical name of the payment method.

Redirect.description: Redirect the consumer browser to this URL to authenticate the payment method. After authentication, the browser will be sent to the specified Return URL.

400.description: If present, the create request structure was invalid and unable to be parsed.

404.description: If present, a value of the request was unable to be found. For example, if the MerchantId provided could not be found in the given environment

503.description: There was a system problem and the request should be tried again.

2XX.description: If present, the order could not be created due to an error. An HTTP 200 status code will be returned to indicate that the request was structured properly but an error was encountered.

Error.description: If there was an error when processing a POST request this is the error structure returned.

Code.description: A request-specific error code, described in the Error Codes section for the specific request.

Message.description: A short description of the error.
